title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Third edition, Volume 16, RAN-SCO - EB.5
text: The platform which the youthful mind receives from valid description, though wild and romantic, approaches to relacy, and often makes an imperfection which remains invisible. Whilst of School the first book which charmed the opening mind or Ruddinam was Divid’s Meta-morpholes; nor did he cease to reall the beauties of this author when his judgment was mature, for during the redi of his life Oval was his favourite post.
